ENFORCING, with the two inline <script> blocks pinned by SHA-256 hash rather than 'unsafe-inline' — the promotion this block previously asked for (shipped Report-Only in PR #94, with a note to promote it once reports were clean and swap 'unsafe-inline' for hashes at the same time). Verified against the real production build in a browser BEFORE enforcing, which is how two breakages were caught that no policy-text assertion would find: posthog-js loads its runtime from us-assets.i.posthog.com (a different host from its api_host), and the font stylesheet's onload= swap was blocked because CSP hashes never cover inline event handlers — it is a hashed <script> now. src/test/csp.test.ts recomputes the hashes from index.html and fails if they drift; a stale hash is silent in production and costs the pre-paint theme or the boot-splash timeout. The Report-Only twin is retired: it allowed 'unsafe-inline' and lacked the PostHog assets host, so it only produced violations this policy correctly permits.
